facts.text: Mount Lofty House was built in 1852 by statesman Arthur Hardy as his summer house.
facts.excerpt: Mount Lofty House was built in 1852 by prominent statesman Arthur Hardy as his summer house.

facts.text: The house was built on the summit of Mount Lofty.
facts.excerpt: Hardy and his wife Martha built their summer house on the summit of Mount Lofty in 1852

facts.text: The original house was burnt to the ground in the 1983 Ash Wednesday fires.
facts.excerpt: In the disastrous 1983 fires of Ash Wednesday Mount Lofty House was burnt to the ground

facts.text: It reopened as a luxury boutique hotel on 12 February 1986 after being completely rebuilt.
facts.excerpt: marking the moment it reopened on 12th February 1986 after being completely rebuilt following the devastating Ash Wednesday Bushfires of 1983

facts.text: The manor passed through several South Australian families and was a commune in the 1970s.
facts.excerpt: the manor was passed through a number of South Australian families, including a period as commune in the 1970s

facts.text: Mount Lofty House is a retreat for adults.
facts.excerpt: Mount Lofty House is an Adults-only retreat.

facts.text: The hotel is 15 minutes from Adelaide CBD and 25 minutes from Adelaide airport.
facts.excerpt: Mount Lofty House is located only 15 minutes from Adelaide CBD and 25 minutes from the Adelaide airport

facts.text: The swimming pool overlooks the Piccadilly Valley.
facts.excerpt: Relax in our swimming pool overlooking the Piccadilly Valley

facts.text: Spa treatments are offered at Gatekeeper's Day Spa.
facts.excerpt: Relax with a spa treatment at Gatekeeper’s Day Spa

facts.text: The Concierge hosts a nightly champagne and house history tour.
facts.excerpt: Nightly champagne and house history tour hosted by our Concierge

facts.text: Guests can explore the Mount Lofty Estate gardens or the neighbouring Botanic Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Explore Mount Lofty Estate gardens or the neighbouring Botanic Gardens

facts.text: Guests can play billiards or chess or relax in the house library.
facts.excerpt: Challenge your partner with a game of billiards, chess or relax in the house library

facts.text: Piccadilly Valley View rooms in the Piccadilly Wing have views across the Piccadilly Valley, a sitting area and outdoor balconies.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Piccadilly Wing, our spacious Piccadilly Valley View rooms offer breathtaking views across Piccadilly Valley with sitting area and outdoor balconies.

facts.text: Piccadilly Valley View rooms feature work by local artist Stephen Trebilcock and a library of books.
facts.excerpt: perfectly complemented with local artist Stephen Trebilcock’s work as well as a library of books

facts.text: The Tower Suite is set over two levels, overlooks the pool and gardens, and has a loft bedroom and spa bath.
facts.excerpt: Our magnificent Tower Suite is set over two levels and overlooks the pool and across the gardens. Loft bedroom and spa bath.

facts.text: Sequoia Lodge suites are sustainably designed, with tree-top views over the Piccadilly Valley and vineyards.
facts.excerpt: sustainably designed suites with unparalleled tree-top views overlook the Piccadilly Valley and vineyards

facts.text: Sequoia Lodge has its own reception area, lounge, breakfast room and mineral hot springs.
facts.excerpt: Sequoia provides the highest level of privacy, its own reception area, lounge and breakfast room, mineral hot springs

facts.text: Coachman's Cottage is a self-contained 1850s cottage.
facts.excerpt: This beautifully renovated 1850’s cottage is fully self-contained and features three bedrooms and one bathroom.

facts.text: Hardy's Verandah Restaurant holds a 3-Hat rating from the Australia Good Food Guide.
facts.excerpt: Australia Good Food Guide 3-Hat for Hardy’s Verandah Restaurant 2024 & the last 5 years

facts.text: Hardy's Verandah's wine list has more than 1300 Australian and international wines, housed in the historic 1852 wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: Three Glass Wine List featuring more than 1300 bottles of Australian and International Wines which are housed in our historic 1852 wine cellar

facts.text: The Garden Dome sits in the garden beneath a 170-year-old Sequoia tree.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the garden beneath the 170-year-old Sequoia Tree is our Garden Dome.

facts.text: Mount Lofty Estate won the Australian Hotels Association Best Overall Hotel award in 2025, 2024 and 2023.
facts.excerpt: Australian Hotels Association Winner Best Overall Hotel Mount Lofty Estate 2025, 2024 & 2023

facts.text: The hotel calls itself an iconic designer 5 star boutique hotel in the Adelaide Hills.
facts.excerpt: 175 Years in the making we are an iconic designer 5 STAR boutique hotel in the Adelaide Hills
